find_cves_by_product.description: Find every vulnerability that affects a piece of software or hardware, named by its CPE. Give an exact CPE name to ask about one version, or a match string with '*' in the version field to ask about the product as a whole, optionally narrowed to a version range. Use 'Search products' first if you do not know the CPE.

description: Search the US government's National Vulnerability Database, run by NIST. Look up a CVE and get its description, CVSS scores, CWE weakness types, affected product versions and references; find every vulnerability in a product by its CPE; filter by severity, weakness or CVSS vector; list what was published or rescored in a date range; and pull the CVEs CISA confirms are being exploited right now. Also covers the CPE product dictionary, the match criteria behind a CVE's affected-version ranges, every recorded change to a CVE record, and the organizations that supply the data. No account is needed; a free NIST API key raises the rate limit.
